title: Using your documentation
lead: Find answers, choose a comfortable appearance, and record acceptance results.

overview.text: Technical documents explain how a system works. User guides help you complete a task. Acceptance plans let you record what happened when you tested a change. All three use the same reader.

blocks.text: Open the HTML document in a browser. These examples need no sign-in. Keep an acceptance plan open until you have generated and retained its summary: results and notes are not retained on reload.

items: Use the document menu on the left. On a narrow screen, open Browse documentation near the top.
Enter a word in Find in this document to narrow the menu.
Choose a matching topic to jump to it. Press Escape in the search field to clear your search.

blocks.text: The selected topic appears in the reading area. Search filters the menu; it does not remove document content.

items: Find Appearance at the bottom of the document menu.
Choose Dark for forest colors, Light for cream colors, or System to follow your device.

blocks.text: Your choice is remembered in this browser when storage is available. It can apply to other Documancer documents on the same origin.

items: Read the acceptance plan's Overview and complete Shared setup.
Read each test's prerequisites. Follow its test plan and compare what you see with Pass when.
Choose Passed, Failed, Skipped, Blocked or Untested. Add notes about your observations; you may write them before choosing a result.

blocks.title: Record what happened
blocks.text: Passed means you accept that journey. Blocked means something prevented execution. Skipped and Untested do not count as accepted.

items: Go to the plan's final Summary section.
Select Generate summary. It generates the text and copies it in one action.
Check the confirmation, then paste the result into your task or message. If copying is blocked, copy the selected text using Ctrl+C or Command+C.
If you change a result or note afterward, generate the summary again before sharing.

blocks.text: Try a shorter word or press Escape in the search field to restore the full menu.
Reloading resets the plan. Record your observations again, then generate and retain the summary before closing the page.
